title: pi-zvec config
description: Global <agent-dir>/extensions/zvec.json, overridden per key by <project-root>/.pi/extensions/zvec.json. Values of the wrong type are ignored.

$schema.description: Editor JSON Schema reference; not a runtime setting.

autoInit.description: Build a zvec-grep index in the background when none is found walking up from cwd (UI modes only; never in the home dir or a filesystem root).

syncOnSettle.description: Run an incremental index after each completed agent turn. Existing indexes still sync once at startup regardless.

embedding.description: zg embedding model used to build and query the index. Blank values fall back to the default.
